BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Make room for the full picture.

  1. Position the camera to show your full body.
  2. Keep one person in frame with good lighting.
  3. Use replay to test a possible-fall alert safely.
Experimental detection, not a medical device. Intentional lying down can trigger alerts.
